besluite.rede: 'Volg die lyn rond' is understandable Afrikaans, while 'al om' without an object ('al om die provinsie') reads incomplete, so the proposal is not clearly better.
Both maps just named are 'kaart', so 'die kaart' is no less ambiguous than 'dit' and adds a third 'kaart' in three sentences; the original 'dit' fittingly covers whichever map the learner has.
